accessibility.aria_roles: Ensure coupon cards use button role if tappable. Out of window coupons should use aria-disabled='true'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a mock HTML/React page targeting ~390px mobile viewport.
Do NOT redesign the whole page. Assume the outer background is #F8F9FA.
Implement the 5 specific states exactly as detailed.
For the horizontal scrolling list, hide the scrollbar (`.scrollbar-hide { -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none; } .scrollbar-hide::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }`).
Ensure parent of 'Best Offer' badge has `relative` positioning and DOES NOT have `overflow-hidden` so the badge can break the bounds.
Apply `data-testid` properties to every interactive node.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where necessary.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Always use lucide-react.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
